{"consolidated_memory":"## Recurring Issue: Hang on Exit in cli/commands/deploy.py (Developer Tooling)

The deploy command's hang on exit behavior has recurred five times with different root causes, each confined to specific conditions. All instances manifest the same signal: a process that finishes work but never returns. Repro for all: deploy the sample project and wait.

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-13] — v1 SDK Client Version Hang
- **Trigger**: Clients pinned to v1 SDK only
- **Root cause**: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #1787, branch fix/hang-on-exit-1)
- **Outcome**: Error rate dropped from 4.8% to under 0.06% (6 per ten thousand)

### Occasion 2: [2026-01-20] — Connection Pool Exhaustion Under Proxy Traffic
- **Trigger**: Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- **Root cause**: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- **Fix**: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #1804, branch fix/hang-on-exit-2)
- **Outcome**: p99 latency fell from 6.7 s to 377 ms

### Occasion 3: [2026-04-28] — Schema Drift After Retry
- **Trigger**: Only after the client had already retried once
- **Root cause**: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- **Fix**: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #2329, branch fix/hang-on-exit-3)
- **Outcome**: Memory settled at 643 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB

### Occasion 4: [2026-07-06] — Slice Bound Off-by-One for Large Tenants
- **Trigger**: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root cause**: An off-by-one in the slice bound
- **Fix**: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #3656, branch fix/hang-on-exit-4)
- **Outcome**: The alert stayed quiet for 9 consecutive days

### Occasion 5: [2026-08-07] — Unbounded Retry Loop in Nested Inputs
- **Trigger**: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Root cause**: An unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix**: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #5018, branch fix/hang-on-exit-5)
- **Outcome**: Reclaimed 96 GB of blob storage

---

All work occurred in the same corner of cli/commands/deploy.py; context carried over between incidents."}
